en.bdb: The life patron of Puranas, is the perfect Supreme Soul.
Har, the Sustaining Lord, is not deficient in protection.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਾ॥
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran praanapat sadh sadhaa hajooraa||

en.bdb: He is spectacular, and with his marvels, profusely he is Satguru, the True Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੂਰਾ॥
verses.translit_en: veh pragaTio purakh bhagava(n)t roop gur gobi(n)dh sooraa||

en.bdb: Hail! Manifested is the Supreme Being in the countenance of gallant Guru Gobind Singh,

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਜੀਅ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੀ ਵੇਲਾ॥
verses.translit_en: anadh binodhee jeea jap sach sachee velaa||

en.bdb: Remember day and night, the virtues of Har who, at the times honest, endows truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: vaeh vaeh gobi(n)dh si(n)gh aape gur chelaa ||14||

en.bdb: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.
